title: Detective Game
subtitle: Third Person | Narrative | Puzzle Solving | Shooting
content: Third Person | Narrative | Puzzle Solving | Shooting
summary: Built a solo third-person detective prototype with quests, dialogue, shooting, IK, and puzzle systems.
description: A third-person narrative prototype made in Unity and C#. The game follows Derek, a detective returning to the force after a nine-month absence caused by an accident. Players solve an assigned case while uncovering what happened during Derek's comatose state.

highlights.name: Dialogue System
highlights.detail: A dialogue system branching different dialogue options. Messages can trigger different quests, and fire events of its own.

highlights.name: IK System
highlights.detail: Combined the animations in game with IK Rig system to make it feel more natural.

highlights.name: Pick up and Drop Puzzle System
highlights.detail: Puzzle type: pick up and drop objects in right slots created for tutorial.

highlights.name: Scriptable Objects for Data Management
highlights.detail: Scriptable objects used for storing dialogues, quests, pick up objects, etc.

highlights.name: Shooting System
highlights.detail: Shooting mode allows player to fire projectiles in targeted direction. Shooting enabled and disabled state.

highlights.name: Quest System
highlights.detail: A robust quest system coupled with event system created. Different events handled: Key pressed, Object picked up, Enemy killed.

roles: Designed and developed as a solo project
Designed the narrative, quest structure, and core game mechanics
Wrote the full game narrative and dialogue content
Planned and tracked tasks using Confluence and JIRA
details: A third-person narrative prototype made in Unity and C#. The game follows Derek, a detective returning to the force after a nine-month absence caused by an accident. Players solve an assigned case while uncovering what happened during Derek's comatose state. This was a solo project developed over two months, including the design phase.
